origin: 44 was the number on Hamilton's first kart. He returned to it in 2014, the first season in which Formula 1 drivers chose a permanent career number, and has raced with it since.

stages.text: The first kart carried 44. A number chosen because it was on the plate, not because it meant anything yet.
Formula Renault, Formula 3 Euro Series, GP2. Different numbers, one championship each, three years.
Numbers assigned by constructors' standing. 2, 22, 1, 2, 3, 4, 10. The number belonged to the team, not the driver.
Permanent numbers arrive. Hamilton takes 44 and wins six world championships carrying it.
44 in red. The one element of the livery that did not change.

note: A world champion may run number 1. Hamilton has never used it.
